title: pr-19730-helm-private-values-init-hooks-refactor: refactor values schema and init hooks for Private installer
author: Ethan Shaw
body:
Context: Private deployments require more robust Helm chart validation and lifecycle hooks to ensure secrets, KMS keys, and pre-populated volumes are created before the main pods start. Existing charts had a few runtime race conditions during first install and during upgrades which caused transient failures in the installer. This PR centralizes values schema validation, refactors init hooks into a dedicated templates/init-jobs.yaml with proper hook weights and deletion policies, and makes the values schema stricter to catch misconfigurations earlier.

What I changed (summary):
- Add charts/private/values.schema.json with explicit JSONSchema for all top-level values used by Private (kms, vpc, storage, initJobs, hooks). This expands validation for KMS ARNs, S3-like storage configs, and optional installerFeatures toggles.
- Introduce charts/private/templates/init-jobs.yaml: consolidated init jobs for pre-provisioning (secrets sync, volume population, cert bootstrap). Jobs run as pre-install and pre-upgrade hooks where appropriate.
- Add charts/private/templates/hooks.yaml: smaller helper hooks used by restore/backup paths and upgrade lifecycle. Ensures hook deletePolicy: "before-hook-creation"/"hook-succeeded" where necessary.
- Update Chart.yaml and README with notes on new values and recommended upgrade path.
- Add unit/helm tests under charts/private/tests/ to verify linting against the new schema and simulate pre-upgrade behavior.
- Minor templating fixes in charts/private/templates/deployment.yaml to tolerate missing optional envs when installerFeatures.disabled=true.

Motivation: Several customer installs in our early access program failed during first-run when the cert bootstrap job overlapped with pod startup. This caused retries that exceeded readiness probes and blocked installer progression. By moving init logic into dedicated, ordered hooks and validating inputs up-front we reduce runtime surprises and make upgrades safer.

Testing performed:
- Local helm lint against charts/private using helm v3.14 - no lint failures.
- helm template + kubeval against values schema to ensure schema catch misconfigs.
- End-to-end dry-run against a minikube cluster to validate hook ordering and job lifecycle.
- CI: initial run failed on schema because k8s version matrix had a mismatch; fixed schema references and re-ran. Final CI status: pass.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main and publish new chart version 1.8.0.
- Notify Private installer early access customers; recommend a canary upgrade for Dedicated staging clusters.
- Monitor canary for 48 hours, watch for crashloop events tied to init jobs.

Open items / follow-ups:
- Add an optional CRD-based installerStatus in a follow-up PR to better surface init job progress to the console (ENG-3620).
- Consider making KMS validation pluggable for on-prem HSMs in a separate ticket.

Checklist:
- [x] Schema added and validated
- [x] Init hooks refactored and ordered
- [x] Tests added and passing in CI
- [x] Docs/README updated with upgrade notes

References: Linear ENG-3567, ENG-3620; Support ticket SUP-1284.

review_comments: Ava Patel: Please add explicit validation for kms.keyArn shape - we saw a customer pass an AWS ARN-like string that caused KMS client initialization to fail. Suggest JSON Schema pattern for arn:aws:kms:...
Ethan Shaw: Added regex pattern to values.schema.json and included a short note in README about acceptable formats.
Carlos Mendes: Hooks look good, but weight ordering needs to be explicit to avoid concurrency. Can we set weights and document why?
Ethan Shaw: Set explicit hook weights (0 for secrets, 5 for cert-bootstrap, 10 for storage-populate). Added comments in templates/init-jobs.yaml explaining rationale.

Priya Rao: Helm lint failed on first CI run due to unknown k8s apiVersion in the test manifest. Please run helm template with the same k8s matrix as CI.

Also add a rollback note in Chart README in case init job partially succeeds.
Ethan Shaw: Fixed apiVersion mismatch in test manifests and added rollback guidance to README. CI re-run passed.
release_notes:
- charts/private: stricter values schema and init hooks (pre-install, pre-upgrade). Improves reliability during first install and upgrades.
- Users upgrading should follow README notes and perform a canary upgrade.
